rev: Articles of Organization for Florida Limited Liability Company with cover letter (CR2E047)
notes: Florida Division of Corporations' articles of organization with its cover letter. Addresses go in as one line each and are split into street and city, state and ZIP on the printed lines. Article IV takes one manager or authorized member per line: 'AMBR or MGR, name, address'. The registered agent's signature and the member's signature are left for them.

lines.en: Name of the limited liability company (must contain "Limited Liability Company", "L.L.C." or "LLC")
lines.zh: 有限责任公司名称（须含 "Limited Liability Company"、"L.L.C." 或 "LLC"）

lines.en: Mailing address of the principal office
Registered agent: name (an individual or a business registered in Florida, not the LLC itself)
lines.zh: 注册代理人：姓名（个人或在佛州注册的企业，不能是本 LLC）

lines.en: Registered agent: Florida street address (no P.O. box)
lines.zh: 注册代理人：佛州街道地址（不可用邮政信箱）

lines.en: Managers or authorized members: one per line, "AMBR or MGR, name, address"
lines.zh: 经理或授权成员：每行一位，"AMBR 或 MGR, 姓名, 地址"

hint.en: e.g. "AMBR, Mei Chen, 2210 NE 2nd Ave, Miami, FL 33137"; up to four.
hint.zh: 如 "AMBR, Mei Chen, 2210 NE 2nd Ave, Miami, FL 33137"；最多四位。

lines.en: Effective date, if other than the filing date (optional)
lines.zh: 生效日期（如不同于提交日期，可选）

lines.en: Typed or printed name of the member or authorized representative signing
lines.zh: 签署人（成员或授权代表）正楷姓名

lines.en: Return correspondence to: "name, firm or company, address"
lines.zh: 回函寄送："姓名, 公司, 地址"

hint.en: e.g. "Mei Chen, Lotus Tea LLC, 2210 NE 2nd Ave, Miami, FL 33137".
hint.zh: 如 "Mei Chen, Lotus Tea LLC, 2210 NE 2nd Ave, Miami, FL 33137"。

lines.en: Email for future annual report notices
lines.zh: 接收年报通知的电子邮箱
如有疑问请致电："姓名, 电话"

options: $160.00 with a certificate of status and a certified copy

name.text: Must conatin the words Limited Liability Company LLC or LLC

agent_address.text: Florida street address PO Box NOT acceptable

other_provisions.text: ARTICLE VI Other provisions if any 1
ARTICLE VI Other provisions if any 2
ARTICLE VI Other provisions if any 3
